standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter together with the chapter More on Morphisms, the passage from a separated scheme of finite type to a proper scheme by compactification, together with the spectral sequence computing the cohomology of an open subscheme from that of the compactification and of the boundary

core_obligations: Proper case (proof lines 9845-9852): for a proper scheme the author applies the companion finiteness and vanishing results of the chapter to obtain the bound.

Separated case (proof lines 9852-9860): a separated scheme of finite type over k can be compactified, and the spectral sequence relating the cohomology of the compactification, the boundary and the open subscheme carries the vanishing from the proper case to the separated case, giving the stated bound.
proof_roadmap: Use the companion vanishing for the proper case.
Compactify the separated scheme of finite type.
Apply the long exact sequence or spectral sequence of the compactification to obtain the bound for the open subscheme.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a separated scheme of finite type over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p the mod p etale cohomology vanishes above dim(X) + 1 (statement lines 9837-9843). The proof disposes of the proper case with the companion vanishing results of the chapter (proof lines 9845-9852) and then passes to the separated case by compactification together with the exact sequence relating the cohomology of a scheme, a closed subscheme and its complement (proof lines 9852-9860). The non-formal content is the compactification step. The claim is H2: one companion input plus one comparison argument.
